use_case: Electric load-forecasting model: hourly day-ahead and 7-day system and substation load forecasts used for wholesale scheduling and peak-day operating plans
business_owner: Manager of Power Supply and Rates
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted regression model built by the Load Forecasting Analyst in the cloud analytics workspace
data_categories: SCADA substation load history; AMI interval data aggregated to substation level (no individual customer records); weather forecasts; calendar; rooftop solar estimates
affects_individuals: No (grid-level; indirect effect on customers through peak-day operating plans)
human_in_the_loop: Manager of Power Supply and Rates approves every day-ahead schedule; Manager of System Operations approves peak-day operating plans; no automatic control action
applicable_laws: No AI-specific federal or Florida law identified. Not a BES Cyber System (outside NERC CIP scope). Wholesale supply contract scheduling terms. Guidance: NIST AI RMF 1.0; NIST concept note for an AI RMF Critical Infrastructure Profile (2026-04-07)
